title: WoT Blitz Memory Offset Table
description: Discovered memory offsets for reading replay state from the game process.

executableSha256.description: SHA-256 of wotblitz.exe, for exact binary matching.

discoveredAtUtc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when offsets were last updated; null for an unpopulated placeholder.

replayTime.description: Base-relative offset for replay timeline (double, seconds). 0 = unknown.

playerHP.description: Base-relative offset for player HP (int32). 0 = unknown.

playerPositionX.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the position is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float X at record +0x10.

playerPositionY.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the position is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float Y at record +0x14.

playerPositionZ.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the position is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float Z at record +0x18.

playerYaw.description: Base-relative offset for player yaw (float, radians). 0 = unknown.

playerPitch.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the pitch is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float pitch at ring-record +0x2C (rotation triple, 2026-08-12 reconciliation).

playerRoll.description: Chained field: see `chains`. The integer stays 0 (the roll is reached through the module-relative chain, not a direct base-relative offset). float roll at ring-record +0x28 (rotation triple, 2026-08-12 reconciliation).

cameraPitch.description: Base-relative offset for camera pitch (float, radians). 0 = unknown.

aliveTankCount.description: Base-relative offset for alive tank count (int32). 0 = unknown.

chains.description: Module-relative pointer chain for chained fields (position family). offsets.<field> stays 0 for chained fields by design: the runtime observation path computes moduleBase + offset, which cannot represent a chain, and the ring record itself is battle-scoped heap. The resolver reads chained fields via its own hash-bound layout. Hops: rootRva first, recordOffset last, memberOffset/inlineOffset/ringIndex/entityLookup in between. memberOffset dereferences a pointer at (object + value); inlineOffset adds value WITHOUT dereferencing (an inline member, e.g. the entities map); ringIndex selects an INLINE ring entry at (object + value + index*stride) using the Int32 index field at (object + indexOffset) — no ring pointer dereference; entityLookup resolves an entity-map lookup (cached fast path + alternative tree roots) with its descriptor on the hop, the target entity id supplied per walk. The 11.19.0.10 position chains are mechanically walkable since OD-RECOVERY-084 (2026-08-10): inlineOffset (entities map, no deref) + entityLookup (cache fast path + alternative tree roots, node layout in the descriptor, target id per walk) + INLINE ringIndex, proven equivalent to the resolver by Walk_PublishedTableChains_*. The pre-publication memberOffset-spelled form remains in git history (commit 0e6bdba) and the ledger.

indexOffset.description: Required for ringIndex: Int32 current-index field offset in the object holding the INLINE ring array.

stride.description: Required for ringIndex: INLINE ring entry stride.

cachedEntityOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: member offset of the cached-entity pointer in the entity map.

entityIdOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: member offset of the Int32 entity id in an entity record (cache fast-path match).

treeRootOffsets.description: Required for entityLookup: ALTERNATIVE tree-map root member offsets, tried in order.

treeNodeSize.description: Required for entityLookup: id-keyed binary-tree node record size.

treeNodeNilOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: nil-flag byte offset in a tree node (1 = nil).

treeNodeKeyOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: Int32 key offset in a tree node.

treeNodeValueOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: pointer-to-entity offset in a tree node.

treeNodeChildLessOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: child pointer offset when target < key.

treeNodeChildGreaterOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: child pointer offset when target > key.

treeSentinelFirstNodeOffset.description: Required for entityLookup: first-node pointer offset in the sentinel.

maxTreeNodes.description: Required for entityLookup: node-budget guard per tree traversal.

fieldValidation.description: Per-field promotion status and provenance evidence.

confidence.description: How confident we are in these offsets.

notes.description: Free-form notes about discovery process, quirks, or caveats.
